jp: \t\t異なる二つの力を宿した指輪。再生能力を補助する役割も持っている。赤と青のラインが螺旋のように絡み合うデザイン。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t異なる二つの力を宿した指輪。再生能力を補助する役割も持っている。赤と青のラインが螺旋のように絡み合うデザイン。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: The ring possesses two different elemental powers. It also assists the regenerative capabilities. The red and blue lines intertwine like a spiral. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "The ring possesses two different elemental powers. It also assists the regenerative capabilities. The red and blue lines intertwine like a spiral. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un anello in cui abitano due forze diverse. Ha anche il compito di dare una mano alla capacità di rigenerarsi. Nel disegno, una linea rossa e una azzurra si intrecciano come una spirale. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t元素の神が生み出した、魔力を封じる指輪。強大な魔力をも抑え込む。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t元素の神が生み出した、魔力を封じる指輪。強大な魔力をも抑え込む。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Ring that seals magic power, created by the God of Elements. It suppresses immense amounts of magical power. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Ring that seals magic power, created by the God of Elements. It suppresses immense amounts of magical power. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un anello che sigilla il potere magico, nato dal dio degli elementi. Tiene a bada anche un potere magico immenso. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t人を常に加速させる魔力が込められた指輪。老化するという弊害はないので、愛用している冒険者も多いようだ。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t人を常に加速させる魔力が込められた指輪。老化するという弊害はないので、愛用している冒険者も多いようだ。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: This ring is filled with magical power that constantly accelerates a person. Since it has no harmful effects of aging, many adventurers seem to love using it. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "This ring is filled with magical power that constantly accelerates a person. Since it has no harmful effects of aging, many adventurers seem to love using it. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un anello in cui è racchiuso un potere magico che tiene una persona sempre accelerata. Non ha la controindicazione di far invecchiare, e pare che molti avventurieri se ne servano volentieri. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t周辺の季候を感じ取り、悪天候に合わせて効果を発揮する指輪。その際指輪は柔らかい光を放ち、周囲に静穏を保つ力場を作り出すのだという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t周辺の季候を感じ取り、悪天候に合わせて効果を発揮する指輪。その際指輪は柔らかい光を放ち、周囲に静穏を保つ力場を作り出すのだという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: The ring senses the surrounding seasonal weather and is effective in bad weather. In doing so, the ring emits a soft light and creates a force field that maintains tranquility in the surrounding area. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "The ring senses the surrounding seasonal weather and is effective in bad weather. In doing so, the ring emits a soft light and creates a force field that maintains tranquility in the surrounding area. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un anello che sente il clima intorno e fa effetto quando il tempo si guasta. In quel momento, dicono, manda una luce morbida e crea attorno a sé un campo di forza che tiene la calma. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t婚礼の儀において、伴侶となる者へ送られる愛のこめられた指輪。当然ながらこの指輪は伴侶の所有物となるので、無理やり取り上げようものなら激しい怒りを買うこととなろう。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t婚礼の儀において、伴侶となる者へ送られる愛のこめられた指輪。当然ながらこの指輪は伴侶の所有物となるので、無理やり取り上げようものなら激しい怒りを買うこととなろう。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: Rings of love are given to the spouse at the wedding ceremony. Naturally, the ring belongs to the spouse, and forcibly taking it away from him or her will provoke his or her fury. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "Rings of love are given to the spouse at the wedding ceremony. Naturally, the ring belongs to the spouse, and forcibly taking it away from him or her will provoke his or her fury. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un anello carico d'amore, che nel rito nuziale si dona a chi diventa compagno di vita. È chiaro che da quel momento l'anello appartiene a lui, e a strapparglielo per forza ci si tira addosso una collera furiosa. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t指にはめる輪状の装具。儀礼的なことに用いる簡素なものや、重大な魔力が封じ込められたもの等、その種類は多様であるという。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t指にはめる輪状の装具。儀礼的なことに用いる簡素なものや、重大な魔力が封じ込められたもの等、その種類は多様であるという。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: Rings of ornaments worn on the fingers. There are a variety of types, including simple ones used for ceremonial purposes and ones in which significant magical power is enclosed. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "Rings of ornaments worn on the fingers. There are a variety of types, including simple ones used for ceremonial purposes and ones in which significant magical power is enclosed. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un oggetto a forma di cerchio che si infila al dito. Ce n'è di ogni specie: dai più semplici, buoni per le cerimonie, a quelli in cui è sigillato un potere magico grave. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\tより指を守ることに特化した指輪。装飾品としての価値は低いが、身を守る際にはこちらの方が良いと言えるだろう。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tより指を守ることに特化した指輪。装飾品としての価値は低いが、身を守る際にはこちらの方が良いと言えるだろう。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: This ring is more specialized in protecting the finger. Although less valuable as an ornament, this is a better choice when protecting oneself. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "This ring is more specialized in protecting the finger. Although less valuable as an ornament, this is a better choice when protecting oneself. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un anello fatto apposta per proteggere meglio il dito. Come ornamento vale poco, ma quando si tratta di difendersi è questo che conviene. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t多様な素材を混ぜ合わせ、より高みを目指した指輪。耐久性に富む為斬新な試みをした作品も多く、通常のものよりはやや値段が張るようだ。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t多様な素材を混ぜ合わせ、より高みを目指した指輪。耐久性に富む為斬新な試みをした作品も多く、通常のものよりはやや値段が張るようだ。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: Rings made by mixing a variety of materials to achieve a higher level of performance. Many of them are more expensive than ordinary rings because of their durability and novelty. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "Rings made by mixing a variety of materials to achieve a higher level of performance. Many of them are more expensive than ordinary rings because of their durability and novelty. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un anello che punta più in alto mescolando materiali di ogni sorta. Siccome dura molto se ne vedono parecchi nati da tentativi arditi, e pare che costino un po' più dei soliti. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t青緑色の宝石を携えた小さくかわいらしい指輪。秘められた力によって、所有者の気品を高めるという。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t青緑色の宝石を携えた小さくかわいらしい指輪。秘められた力によって、所有者の気品を高めるという。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: Lovely small ring with a blue-green gemstone. It is said to enhance the owner's nobility through its hidden power. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Lovely small ring with a blue-green gemstone. It is said to enhance the owner's nobility through its hidden power. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Un anello piccolo e grazioso, che porta una gemma verde-azzurra. Dicono che, con una forza nascosta, alzi l'eleganza di chi lo possiede. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t鋼鉄竜の骨から作られたとされる武骨な指輪。身につければ自らが鋼鉄竜となったと錯覚させる程の強大な力を得るという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t鋼鉄竜の骨から作られたとされる武骨な指輪。身につければ自らが鋼鉄竜となったと錯覚させる程の強大な力を得るという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Ring said to have been made from the bones of a steel dragon. It is said to be so powerful that the wearer is made to believe he or she has become a steel dragon. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Ring said to have been made from the bones of a steel dragon. It is said to be so powerful that the wearer is made to believe he or she has become a steel dragon. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un anello rozzo, che dicono ricavato dalle ossa di un drago d'acciaio. A portarlo si acquista una forza tanto immensa da far credere di essere diventati un drago d'acciaio. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t様々な飾りがとても美しい指輪。かつて、この小さな円の中にどれだけの彩を凝らすかで職人の腕が競われたことがあったという。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t様々な飾りがとても美しい指輪。かつて、この小さな円の中にどれだけの彩を凝らすかで職人の腕が競われたことがあったという。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: Beautiful ring with a variety of decorations. It is said that once there was a competition among craftsmen to see how much color they could put onto this small ring. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "Beautiful ring with a variety of decorations. It is said that once there was a competition among craftsmen to see how much color they could put onto this small ring. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un anello reso bellissimo da ornamenti d'ogni sorta. Dicono che un tempo gli artigiani si sfidassero a chi riuscisse a stipare più colore dentro quel piccolo cerchio. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~
